text.description_html:
Fusion 28-E4, Clear Glass Egg-Shaped Knobset

So often glass knobs are accompanied by overly ornate rosettes, but the Clear Glass Egg Knob with Sonoma Rose has a distinct old west feel that manages to look gorgeous without being too girly--and that is hard to say about a glass knob! We love the juxtaposition of hard and soft lines that this egg-shaped knob and square rose combination has. It is just a beautiful knob that feels like it has a lot of history because of the substance of the rose behind it. The Sonoma Collection Glass Egg Knob and Rose is available in either an oil rubbed bronze (pictured), medium bronze, or antique pewter finishes. It will fit 1-1/4 inch to 2 inch thick doors and has an optional backset for either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches.

Features of the Sonoma Knobset:

  • Solid Brass/Bronze Construction
  • Cycle Tested to ANSI Standards
  • Exclusive Fusion knob spring assembly for lifetime performance
  • Reversible Latchbolt in matching/coordinating finish
  • Easy assembly with alignment block and rose posts

Specifications for the Fusion 28 E4 Sonoma Rose with Glass Egg Knob:

  • Knob Length: 2-5/8"
  • Knob Width: 1-5/8"
  • Knob Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Rose Length: 2-5/8" square
  • Rose Projection: 1/2"
  • Door Thickness: 1-1/4" to 2"
  • Backsets: Either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Knob Material: Glass
  • Standard Latch Rotation is 40 Degrees.
  • Square corner latches and strike plates
  • Lifetime Limited Warranty on workmanship, materials, and operation.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: Non-functional pull to match trim on one side of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock.
  • Dummy Set: Non-functional pull to match trim on both sides of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need locking.
